SAKURAMOD-WIND.title: Wind
SAKURAMOD-WIND.description:
With 5 or more Magic Charge, playing a Windy card enters [gold]Windy state[/gold] until the end of turn.
In Windy state, every 2 Windy cards you play draw 1 card.
SAKURAMOD-WATER.title: Water
SAKURAMOD-WATER.description:
With 5 or more Magic Charge, playing a Watery card enters [gold]Watery state[/gold] until the end of turn.
In Watery state, every 2 Watery cards you play grant 1 Energy.
SAKURAMOD-FIRE.title: Fire
SAKURAMOD-FIRE.description:
With 5 or more Magic Charge, playing a Fiery card enters [gold]Fiery state[/gold] until the end of turn.
In Fiery state, each Fiery card you play deals 3 damage to ALL enemies.
SAKURAMOD-EARTH.title: Earth
SAKURAMOD-EARTH.description:
With 5 or more Magic Charge, playing an Earthy card enters [gold]Earthy state[/gold] until the end of turn.
In Earthy state, each Earthy card you play grants 4 [gold]Block[/gold].
SAKURAMOD-STABILIZE.title: Stabilize
SAKURAMOD-STABILIZE.description: Remove [red]Forgotten[/red] from 1 card in your [gold]Hand[/gold] or [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].
SAKURAMOD-MANIFEST.title: Manifest
SAKURAMOD-MANIFEST.description: Choose 1 of the revealed random Clear Cards and add a copy into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. It gains [red]Forgotten[/red].
SAKURAMOD-SAKURA_CARD.title: Sakura Card
SAKURAMOD-SAKURA_CARD.description: Converted from a Clow Card. When played, shuffle 1 Void into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
SAKURAMOD-ECHO.title: Echo
SAKURAMOD-ECHO.description: When exhausted by The Song, trigger The Song's effect additional times.
SAKURAMOD-INVISIBLE.title: Invisible
SAKURAMOD-REMOVABLE.title: Removable
SAKURAMOD-REMOVABLE.description: After being played, it is removed from your deck. Copies gained during combat have no effect.
SAKURAMOD-COST_DECREASING.title: Cost-Decreasing
SAKURAMOD-COST_DECREASING.description: At the start of each combat, the cost is reduced by 1.
SAKURAMOD-ENTITY_LIMITED.title: Entity-Limited
SAKURAMOD-ENTITY_LIMITED.description: Only works if obtained as a combat reward. Copies gained during combat have no effect.
SAKURAMOD-PURGE.title: Purge
SAKURAMOD-PURGE.description: After being played, it is removed from combat and permanently from your deck.
SAKURAMOD-LONER.title: Loner
SAKURAMOD-LONER.description: For each missing copy of this card in your deck, its value increases by 20%.
SAKURAMOD-FROSTBITE.title: Frostbite
SAKURAMOD-FROSTBITE.description:
Takes 10% more attack damage per stack.
Every 6 stacks become 1 [gold]Freeze[/gold].
Loses 1 stack at the end of its turn.
SAKURAMOD-FADE.title: Fade
SAKURAMOD-FADE.description: At the end of your turn, if this card is in your [gold]Hand[/gold], remove it from combat.
